proposed_ledger_entry: Item 316 gives an exact all-digit Ostrowski classification of the remaining beta intermediate window. For n>=5, a canonical word represents an actual centered half-bound failure if and only if a/(2c)<=R<a/2, 0<|E|<c, and U=(-1)^n sign(E)a; in that case the actual nearest quotient is kappa=|E|. The strict dual-error lemma -S<E<a-S eliminates every endpoint carry. For each fixed s, exact top-two-digit witnesses satisfy the continued-fraction, admissibility, window, sign, and target-congruence data modulo 2^s while failing the integer target, proving only a scoped fixed-precision information-class no-go. The centered half-bound, growing/full 2-adic and odd-modulus routes, proper targets, and every beta capacity consequence remain open. Booking and capacity reduction are zero.
